Article 1 Subject matter and scope
Regulation (EU) 2023/1772
1. The objective of this Regulation is to establish the common rules.
2. This Regulation shall apply to:
(a) aircraft;
Article 2 Definitions
For the purpose of this Regulation the following definitions shall apply:
1. ‘accuracy’ means a degree of conformance;
3. ‘advisory airspace’ means an airspace of defined dimensions;
5. ‘aerial work’ means an aircraft operation;
5a. ‘extra’ means something;
GM1 Article 2(12) Aerial work
ED Decision 2020/007/R
GENERAL
(a) Unlike aerial work, specialised operations do not include search and rescue;
Article 3 Compliance
Regulation (EU) 2016/1185
1. Member States shall comply.

(a) flight visibilities reduced to not less than 1 500 m may be permitted;
